messages.author: 2fd6304ad8dd07e2
messages.subject: fgn models not working
parts:
Hello INLA users

I think some recent INLA update has generated a problem for estimating Fractional Gaussian Noise (FGN) models. My models that ran on older INLA versions are no longer working, and even the example in the documentation (inla.doc('fgn')) is no longer working. Unfortunately I can't identify where the problem is. 
The example in the documentation requires manual installation of the FGN package to generate the sample, but this needs to be done manually using an archived version of this package as it is no longer on CRAN.
Below I copy the last lines of execution, which unfortunately do not allow identifying the error.
I'm using the latest development version of INLA for linux.

best, 

Márcio Laurini 



        CPO manual calculation[No]
        VB-correction is [Disabled]
inla_build: check for unused entries in[/tmp/RtmpdvQmxp/filea3cbb3e46d/Model.ini]
inla_INLA_preopt_experimental...
Error in inla.inlaprogram.has.crashed() :
  The inla-program exited with an error. Unless you interupted it yourself, please rerun with verbose=TRUE and check the output carefully.
  If this does not help, please contact the developers at <he...@r-inla.org>.
Error in inla.core.safe(formula = formula, family = family, contrasts = contrasts,  :
  *** Fail to get good enough initial values. Maybe it is due to something else.
